entities.summary: Oleksandr Tikhonov was a Soviet and Ukrainian pharmacist, Doctor of Pharmacy, Distinguished Professor at the National University of Pharmacy, and President of the Ukrainian Association of Apitherapists. He was Academician of the Ukrainian Academy of Sciences, Honored Scientist of Ukraine (1990), and Laureate of the State Prize of Ukraine in Science and Technology for the year 2013.
